name: Cheech & Chong - Eighth - Ahhberry
description:
Indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, top-shelf. The Cheech & Chong Ahhberry eighth delivers 3.5 grams of premium indoor flower — dense, frosty, and cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Ahhberry brings a sweet, berry-forward profile: ripe blueberry and mixed berry notes up front, layered with soft floral sweetness and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Dense, resin-coated buds with deep color and a nose you can smell the moment the jar opens.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G premium indoor flower — grown in a controlled environment for consistent quality
Hand-trimmed and properly cured — dense, frosty buds with a smooth, even burn
Signature Ahhberry flavor — sweet ripe berry with soft floral and earthy notes
Full terpene expression — rich aroma and flavor straight from the jar
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Premium flower, real flavor, and top-shelf quality in every eighth. Cheech & Chong Ahhberry is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
